en.title: Present forms for the future
en.summary: English often uses present forms to talk about the future.

paragraphs: Besides will and going to, English uses two present forms to talk about the future: the present continuous for fixed arrangements, and the present simple for timetables and schedules.

items: We **are flying** to Rome on Friday.

paragraphs: Use the present continuous when the plan is arranged and usually has a time or place already fixed, such as appointments, trips and meetings.

blocks.html:
FormExample
statementI am seeing the dentist tomorrow.
questionAre you coming to the party?
negativeWe aren't working on Friday.

paragraphs: Use the present simple for events that follow a timetable, a programme or a calendar. The subject is usually a thing, not a person.

blocks.html:
FormExample
transportThe bus leaves at 8:15.
eventsThe film starts at seven.
the calendarChristmas is on a Monday this year.
school or workThe course begins in September.

FormMeaningExample
willprediction, decision, promiseI'll help you.
going toplan or evidenceI'm going to learn Spanish.
present continuousfixed arrangementI'm seeing her at six.
present simplescheduleThe train leaves at six.

items: Wrong: **I see her tomorrow.** Better: **I'm seeing her tomorrow.** (an arrangement)
Wrong: **The train is leaving at nine.** Better: **The train leaves at nine.** (a timetable)
Wrong: **We are meeting on Friday** (when no arrangement exists) → use will or going to.

ro.title: Forme de prezent pentru viitor
ro.summary: În limba română, folosim des timpul prezent pentru acțiuni sigure sau planificate în viitor.

paragraphs: În limba română, poți folosi timpul prezent pentru a exprima viitorul. Acest lucru este foarte obișnuit în vorbirea de zi cu zi. Folosim prezentul pentru planuri sigure sau pentru un program fix. Adăugăm adesea expresii de timp, precum „mâine” sau „diseară”.
Folosești forma normală a verbului la prezent. Verbul își păstrează terminațiile obișnuite de prezent. Pentru claritate, adaugi o expresie de timp care arată când are loc acțiunea.

blocks.html:
Expresie de timpVerb la prezentExemplu complet
MâineplecMâine **plec** la mare.
DisearămergemDiseară **mergem** la film.
Peste o orăîncepeConcertul **începe** peste o oră.
VineriamVineri **am** un examen.
